scripts.build: npm run validate:constraints && npm run validate:data && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.validate:constraints: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),c=fs.readFileSync('src/components/PatchNotesModal.tsx','utf8');const code=c.split('\\n').filter(l=>!l.trim().startsWith('//') && !l.trim().startsWith('*')).join('\\n');const hasRaw=c.includes('PATCH_NOTES.md?raw');const hasFetch=code.includes('fetch(')&&code.includes('PATCH_NOTES');if(!hasRaw||hasFetch){console.error('\\n\u274c CONSTRAINT VIOLATED in PatchNotesModal.tsx:');if(!hasRaw)console.error('  Must import PATCH_NOTES.md via ?raw (bundled at build time)');if(hasFetch)console.error('  Must NOT fetch() patch notes at runtime (see comment at top of file)');console.error('  See CLAUDE.md Critical Technical Constraints for why.\\n');process.exit(1)}console.log('\u2713 PatchNotesModal constraints OK')"
